III. Activity Question — BCD addition of 0101 (5) and 0111 (7)

Steps of BCD addition: (i) add the two 4-bit codes as plain binary; (ii) if the sum exceeds 1001 (9) or produces a carry, add the correction factor 0110; (iii) any carry out becomes the next higher BCD digit (0001).
Result: carry 1 to the tens digit and 0010 in the units digit → 0001 0010 = 12 in BCD. (5 + 7 = 12 ✓)
